## Authority and references

Identify the owner decision, parent issue, and sanitized requirement identifiers.

## Goal and current evidence

Describe the problem and distinguish verified behavior from planned behavior.

## Scope and constraints

State what may change, what must remain unchanged, dependencies, and decision holds.
Do not treat an unresolved proposal as approved.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ]

## Verification plan

Describe observable checks, negative cases, and required evidence without private data.

## Language and preservation

- [ ] The title and engineering prose are English; no parallel Japanese document is introduced.
- [ ] Any original-language localization, test fixture, or quoted evidence has an English explanation and a justified preservation exception.
- [ ] Translation-only work preserves references, decisions, acceptance criteria, checkbox states, and lifecycle metadata; incomplete legacy migration is tracked in #965.
